lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns. The most prominent central column contains three large-diameter circular clusters aligned along a vertical axis posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the blobs serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper lateral flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from light-intensity upper pixels to shadowed lower pixels, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin in the lower-central frame exhibits a high density of small-diameter, lower-luminance specks that contrast with the larger, higher-intensity blobs on the main flank.
